annotations.title: Search Global Remote Hiring Signals & Company Domains

description: Find deduplicated B2B companies actively hiring remote, cross-border, LATAM, Europe, EMEA, and APAC talent across 6 live feeds with verified root company domains (`domain`), careers URLs, disclosed salary ranges, tech stack, and hiring velocity (`corridordata/global-remote-hiring-signals`).

crossBorderOnly.description: Exclude single-country domestic remote roles (e.g. 'US Only') to isolate cross-border / EOR hiring signals.

keywords.description: Optional role, skill, or tech stack keywords (OR logic, e.g. ['python', 'ai', 'devops']).

maxItems.description: Maximum number of deduplicated hiring company leads to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

minOpenRoles.description: Minimum active remote job openings at the same company.

postedWithinDays.description: Only include fresh postings published within the last N days.

targetRegions.description: Filter companies hiring in specific remote regions.

withSalaryOnly.description: Only return companies with disclosed salary ranges.

name: search_remote_hiring_signals
